entities.name: Éva Gauthier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ida Joséphine Phoebe Éva Gauthier was a Canadian-American mezzo-soprano and voice teacher. She performed and popularized songs by contemporary composers throughout her career and sang in the American premieres of several works by Erik Satie, Maurice Ravel and Igor Stravinsky, including the title role in the latter's Perséphone.

entities.name: Éva Gauthier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ida Joséphine Phoebe Éva Gauthier was a Canadian-American mezzo-soprano and voice teacher. She performed and popularized songs by contemporary composers throughout her career and sang in the American premieres of several works by Erik Satie, Maurice Ravel and Igor Stravinsky, including the title role in the latter's Perséphone.
